Name: Izuku Midoriya from My Hero Academia NPC mod
Author: emkabonbonka
Description:
Hello!
This is my first time making a mod, so it’s not perfect yet and there may still be a few bugs.
Izuku is now fully integrated into the valley. He has heart events, can be befriended, dated, married, and you can have children together (adopted or not).
He is also included in multiple festivals throughout the year, with custom dialogue for each one. He no longer disappears during events like the Luau or the Moonlight Jellies.
I’m planning to keep improving the mod with future updates and bug fixes.
If you run into any issues or have feedback, I’d really appreciate hearing about it!
Thanks for checking it out!
[line]
[b]Update 1.0.3[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a new jealousy system: Izuku may react if you gift another NPC while dating him [/*]
[*]Added dating dialogue [/*]
[/list][b][color=#980000]Important[/color]:[/b]
Please download both files and keep the [b]Izuku Jealousy[/b] mod in a separate folder.
Do not place it inside the main Izuku mod folder, or it may not work correctly.
